---
applyTo: "{plugins/**,.github/plugin/marketplace.json,.claude-plugin/marketplace.json,build/marketplace.config.json}"
---

# Plugin Manifest Review Guidelines

## Purpose

Apply when reviewing plugin manifest or marketplace files. CI does not check the routing table or marketplace regeneration — these are authoring-time gates that humans miss. Cite CONTRIBUTING.md "Plugin Manifest Update" section per finding.

## Routing table

A new skill MUST be added to BOTH the axis plugin AND the union plugin `fabric-skills`. Forgetting `fabric-skills` is the most common contribution mistake.

| Skill suffix | Required plugin manifests |
|---|---|
| `-authoring-cli` | `plugins/fabric-authoring/.github/plugin/plugin.json` AND `plugins/fabric-skills/.github/plugin/plugin.json` |
| `-consumption-cli` | `plugins/fabric-consumption/.github/plugin/plugin.json` AND `plugins/fabric-skills/.github/plugin/plugin.json` |
| `-operations-cli` | `plugins/fabric-operations/.github/plugin/plugin.json` AND `plugins/fabric-skills/.github/plugin/plugin.json` |
| `e2e-*` (cross-workload) | `plugins/fabric-skills/.github/plugin/plugin.json` (and the relevant axis plugin if applicable) |
| Migration / project-shaped | `plugins/fabric-skills/.github/plugin/plugin.json` only |

If a new `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` was added in this PR (visible from the diff context), verify the matching plugin manifest entries are also in this PR. Flag missing entries; name the exact path that needs the `"./skills/<name>"` line.

## Marketplace regeneration

`marketplace.json` files at `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` are auto-generated by `python build/build_plugins.py` from per-plugin manifests.

- If any `plugins/*/.github/plugin/plugin.json` changed, BOTH `marketplace.json` files MUST also be in the diff. Flag missing regeneration. CI runs `python build/build_plugins.py --check` and will fail loudly if either drifts.
- If a generated file was edited without a corresponding `plugins/*/plugin.json` change, suspect a hand-edit. Flag -- manual edits will be reverted on the next build.
- The two marketplace files should be byte-identical in structure (regenerated from the same source). Mismatched edits are a red flag.
- The plugin-to-skills mapping consumed by the PR-touched smoke detector, runners, and tests is read DIRECTLY from each `plugins/<name>/.github/plugin/plugin.json` at runtime via `build/plugin_index.py`; there is no denormalized index file to keep in sync.

## New plugin folders

Creating a new top-level `plugins/<new-name>/` folder is core-team-only. Flag any new plugin folder; suggest filing an issue describing the gap so the core team can decide whether to add it to `build/marketplace.config.json`.

## marketplace.config.json

`build/marketplace.config.json` carries collection-level metadata (collection name, owner) and is core-team-only. Flag any contributor-authored edit; suggest filing an issue.
